dz: 瑞典查理十二世在斯摩棱斯克外停止了征服莫斯科的行军，标志着大北方战争的转折点。九个月后，军队在波尔塔瓦战役中被击败，瑞典帝国不再是一个大国。
de: Charles XII of Sweden stops his march to conquer Moscow outside Smolensk, marking the turning point in the Great Northern War. The army is defeated nine months later in the Battle of Poltava, and the Swedish Empire ceases to be a major power.
